inputs.style: Epic aggressive heavy metal, propulsive gallops, melodic independent bass, bright harmonized distorted leads, high powerful male tenor, hard snare attacks. 158 BPM, F sharp minor. minor-key ascending refrain against a descending bass; rhythmic unison stops before the chorus. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust on the viewport, the engine’s a scream
We signed for the stars, not a hollowed-out dream
The captain’s a ghost with a ledger of lies
Counting the souls like a butcher counts flies
The hum of the hull is a ticking clock
We’re moving away from the place we got stuck
But the charts on the wall have been burned to the floor
And the heat is the only thing we can see anymore

[Chorus]
Prisoners of the Ninth Sun
Burning bright where the light is done
We flew from the cold to the heat of the blade
A furnace of gold and a promise we made

[Verse]
The navigator drops his pen on the deck
Says the star isn’t waiting, it’s coming to fetch
The air recyclers are coughing up rust
And the smell of the burning is sweet as dust
I saw the reflection in the steel of the door
A thousand red eyes and a hungry core
We didn’t buy tickets, we bought our own grave
Now we’re walking toward the light, step by step, brave

[Chorus]
Prisoners of the Ninth Sun
Burning bright where the light is done
We flew from the cold to the heat of the blade
A furnace of gold and a promise we made

[Bridge]
Hold the line!
Do not look back!
The void is a mouth and it’s hungry for cracks
Hold the line!
The metal is thin!
We are the fuel and the fire is in

[Solo]

[Chorus]
Prisoners of the Ninth Sun
Burning bright where the light is done
We flew from the cold to the heat of the blade
A furnace of gold and a promise we made

[Outro]
The glass cracks, the air is gone
We belong to the burning dawn
Prisoners... of the Ninth Sun
Gone
